title: Fair Play – the highest value in sport!
body_html:
Setka Cup has signed a memorandum of cooperation with the International Table Tennis Federation (ITTF). The agreement aims to combat manipulation in table tennis, in particular match-fixing and corruption schemes in sport.

The document sets up mechanisms for cooperation and information exchange between the Parties to identify, investigate and prevent manipulation in sport, in line with the principles of the Council of Europe Convention on the Manipulation of Sports Competitions.

The agreement underlines the mutual commitment of Setka Cup and the ITTF to the principles of honesty and transparency in table tennis, and their wish to contribute to the development of the sport internationally.
